name: Remote Transmitter → Transmit Pd Pioneer
description: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions/#all-actions) sends a PD Pioneer mini-split infrared code to a remote transmitter. The checksum byte is added automatically when 13 data bytes are provided.

config_entries.label: Code
config_entries.description: The 13- or 14-byte PD Pioneer code to send as a list of hex or integers. The fourth byte must be `0x01` (settings frame) or `0x02` (fan frame); the checksum byte is filled in for you, so 13 bytes are enough. See dumper output for more info.

config_entries.label: Transmitter ID
config_entries.description: The remote transmitter to send the remote code with. Defaults to the first one defined in the configuration.

config_entries.label: Repeat
config_entries.description: Defines the number of times the code is repeated when transmitted. By default, codes are sent only once.
